text: The explicit profile/package checks passed in this fresh run. The manifest lists separate metric PTH/NPTH files, the verified ZIP and current source/file hashes; the generated CSV matches all ten fitted parts. I will add concise review-only documentation and check the remaining geometry metadata before the strict finish gate.

args.content:
# Stage 6 review-only outputs

Fresh v18 execution on 2026-10-08: native export_outputs produced every requested category and reported JLC KiCad 9 settings/package checks passed. The generated manifest was read in full with state=complete and manufacturerAcceptance=not-verified. The v17 refusal was rolled back; none of its artifacts or pass claims is reused as current evidence. No schematic, PCB, project settings, fitted part or BOM source changed in this stage.

## Review-only restriction

DRAFT / UNQUALIFIED. These exports and the ordering-format BOM are for review only. File generation, profile/package checks and hash consistency do not establish manufacturer acceptance, authorize fabrication or procurement, or qualify physical hardware. All fitted MPNs remain UNVERIFIED. The four raw J1 hole_clearance errors and all electrical, assembly, thermal, mechanical and sourcing qualification conditions remain open.

Rationale: a verified software export is useful for review but is not a fabrication release or a measured hardware result.

## Actual inventory and checks

The native exporter reported nine successful categories with real paths and nonzero sizes: gerbers, drill, outline.dxf, board.step, board.svg, schematic.svg, BOM.csv, jlcpcb.zip and export-manifest.json. The manifest records 18 generated files plus its own separate JSON file.

- outputs/gerbers/: front/back copper, front/back masks, front/back silkscreens, front/back paste and Edge_Cuts, plus the generated job file. Native header readback confirms the actual layer functions.
- outputs/gerbers/protected-usb-c-500-ma-power-breakout-independent-prototype-test-brief-PTH.drl and -NPTH.drl: distinct metric Excellon files; actual headers identify Plated and NonPlated respectively.
- outputs/jlcpcb.zip: 53,593 bytes; generated/verified by the original exporter. SHA-256 a6ce0b3c7e6d661dde3518dc094a8b85ad02aee736cbcadeba713b17c5e96873. This is a draft package, not an upload or an order.
- outputs/outline.dxf/protected-usb-c-500-ma-power-breakout-independent-prototype-test-brief-Edge_Cuts.dxf: actual nested DXF path, 5,820 bytes; EOF found. outline.dxf is a directory, not a top-level DXF file.
- outputs/board.step: 46,352 bytes, ISO-10303-21 with AP214 AUTOMOTIVE_DESIGN schema and terminator verified by native readback. Model completeness and physical fit are not established.
- outputs/board.svg: 120,923 bytes, PCBNEW header verified.
- outputs/renders/protected-usb-c-500-ma-power-breakout-independent-prototype-test-brief.svg: 373,807 bytes, Eeschema-SVG header verified. schematic.svg is the logical category; this is its actual file path. SVG generation is not visual inspection.
- outputs/BOM.csv: generated from docs/BOM.md, 218 bytes, Refdes/MPN/Qty columns. Full readback confirms J1/U1/J2/J3/R1/R2/R4/C1/C2/D1, each Qty=1 for one board. All ten MPNs match the fitted-components table; R3 is intentionally absent. Repeated MPNs retain separate refdes rows. Qty is not a purchase authorization.
- outputs/export-manifest.json: full source hashes, artifact paths, byte counts and SHA-256 records. It was generated by the exporter, not authored manually.

Rationale: use actual paths and verified file identity rather than logical labels or old export results.

## Integrity and zone gate

The current package must match its generated source-bound manifest and file hashes at the original strict finish gate. The current native manifest identifies profile jlcpcb-kicad9-2026-09-24, KiCad 9.0.2 and zoneFill=not-applicable-no-copper-zones. Adding copper zones requires a supported fill-validation workflow; this profile cannot accept an unvalidated fill. Regenerate and reverify exports after any source change; do not hand-edit the manifest or exported artifacts to manufacture a pass.

The fresh manifest's source SHA-256 values are:
- docs/BOM.md: 3d067125c38fb7b1699185b4b6376f0597326e72306b8ffb7d16de689155f49f
- protected-usb-c-500-ma-power-breakout-independent-prototype-test-brief.kicad_pcb: b07e3bfa0236ad11b54fbd4554b2cabb377a1cdee0bb4e1606a0f03e1e854470
- protected-usb-c-500-ma-power-breakout-independent-prototype-test-brief.kicad_pro: 245e11d7de8d31acc0928ce82b9eb6c282a6e25337780b7fdb844e2a9292cbfc
- protected-usb-c-500-ma-power-breakout-independent-prototype-test-brief.kicad_sch: 73583b1e518a445e988d26c6bcf51150fc9e05aefde8086d3ee0cab8d150f0fd

Rationale: bind the package to its exact source revision and preserve the supported validation boundary. The final gate, not this prose, decides whether those hashes are still current.

## Verification and release boundary

Fresh v18 ERC and drift are clean. Fresh native DRC reports clean for the original placement/routing gate, with four separately listed J1 library-internal hole_clearance findings. The unchanged board's documented Stage 5 raw KiCad result has four errors at 0.1944 mm against the unchanged 0.2500 mm minimum, exits 5, and has zero unconnected items. No rules, geometry or suppressions were changed. Specialist/fabricator resolution is mandatory before fabrication; this is not raw-zero DRC. See docs/LAYOUT.md.

Preserve all original targets: 4.75-5.25 V; 500 mA total external load on either connector alone or shared; strictly <2 mA unloaded VBUS over assumed 0-50 C; <USD 8 component BOM at Q100; <=40 x 30 mm, two-layer 1 oz nominal 1.6 mm FR-4 and accessible manual assembly. The 0.831 mA current ledger and USD 2.5439 cost estimate remain conditional. Whole-range bias/leakage, effective capacitance, LED visibility, exact-device thermal/recovery evidence, contact/copper drop, source/cable interaction, manual assembly and all physical tests are outstanding. Final Q100 quotations and header availability are unverified.

J3 finished holes must remain 0.97-1.07 mm; resolve J1 hole spacing, exact connector/device drawing overlays and fine-pitch access. The inherited U1 descriptive metadata limitation in BOM/PINOUT remains: fitted U1 is TPS2065CDBVR, and TPS2051C parent prose is not its rating evidence. Outputs remain load-only, with no backfeed or parallel supplies.

Rationale: package generation neither repairs hardware risks nor closes conditional budgets. Keep the original later firmware-applicability and bring-up/development stages; no programmable device, dummy firmware or fabricated bench result is introduced.

Manufacturer acceptance is explicitly not verified. Use that manifest for the actual paths; DXF is inside outputs/outline.dxf/ and the schematic SVG is inside outputs/renders/. The Gerber/drill ZIP is outputs/jlcpcb.zip. It includes separately generated PTH/NPTH drills. No file was uploaded to a manufacturer.

BOM.csv contains ten fitted refdes, each Qty=1 per board, derived from docs/BOM.md. Every MPN remains UNVERIFIED for final release. The estimated USD 2.5439 Q100 component total includes an uncertain J2 estimate; quotations and header availability remain unresolved.

The current package must match its generated source-bound manifest and file hashes at the original strict finish gate. The current native manifest identifies profile jlcpcb-kicad9-2026-09-24, KiCad 9.0.2 and zoneFill=not-applicable-no-copper-zones. Adding copper zones requires a supported fill-validation workflow; this profile cannot accept an unvalidated fill. Regenerate and reverify exports after any source change; do not hand-edit the manifest or exported artifacts to manufacture a pass.

Before fabrication or energization, resolve the four raw J1 clearance errors and manufacturing/assembly requirements, including J3 finished holes 0.97-1.07 mm. Preserve 40 x 30 mm maximum envelope, two layers, 1 oz copper and nominal 1.6 mm FR-4. Complete all original electrical, thermal, source/cable, polarity/orientation, LED, fault/recovery and assembly qualification. The 0.831 mA budget is conditional, not a measurement or guaranteed maximum. No prototype has been built or tested.

See docs/OUTPUTS.md for actual export evidence and docs/LAYOUT.md, docs/BOM.md and docs/SPEC.md for controlling limitations. Rationale: the warning must travel with usable fabrication-format files.
